data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [After initially receiving two outdoor…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a7b929a09be4ef1f068f00d)
After initially receiving two outdoor pillows with defective zippers, we were very pleased to finally receive a replacement pillow cover that worked perfectly! Throughout the entire process, the customer service team was exceptionally responsive, courteous, and helpful. Their continued follow-up and commitment to resolving the issue were greatly appreciated. Excellent customer service and a very positive experience!

July 30, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Aug 12, 2026

Greg,

We are so glad to hear that we were able to resolve the issue with your outdoor pillow covers and that you are now pleased with the replacement. We truly appreciate your patience and kind words about our customer service team's responsiveness and commitment. Your positive experience means a lot to us!

Lulu and Georgia
